Estimated value EUR 2,443,030.88 excl. VAT, 48-month framework with a single supplier, lowest-price-only award, bid bond EUR 80,000, insurance cover of EUR 11m required. Notice 7846-MSS, Vestnik 111/2026, published 05/06/2026; bid deadline 06/07/2026 10:00 (now passed, award not yet published).
signals.implies: Slovak Post is re-contracting its whole national cash logistics chain 4 years at a time. Printec does not bid guarding, but the CIT winner is the operational partner for any Printec cash-recycling/kiosk estate at Slovak Post and a first-class entry in the competitor register.
signals.followup: Watch UVO zakazka 559013 oznamenia tab for the result notice and the winner.
